title: Infrastructure Architect
description:
**Project Role :** Infrastructure Architect  

**Project Role Description :** Design and govern end\-to\-end data center infrastructure architecture across compute, storage, and networking layers, with a focus on scalable, secure, and cost\-efficient AI\-enabled environments. Define architecture standards and patterns across compute, network, and storage domains, ensuring alignment with security and compliance requirements while supporting business and operational needs.
  

**Must have skills :** Oracle Database Administration (DBA)  

**Good to have skills :** NA  

Minimum **2** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Summary:
  

As an Infrastructure Architect, your day involves designing and overseeing comprehensive data center infrastructure that spans computing, storage, and networking components. You focus on creating environments that are scalable, secure, and optimized for artificial intelligence applications. Your role includes establishing architectural standards and patterns that align with security protocols and compliance mandates, while ensuring the infrastructure supports both business objectives and operational efficiency. Collaboration with various teams to maintain a cohesive and robust infrastructure is a key part of your daily activities.  

  

Roles \& Responsibilities:
  

* Expected to perform independently and become an SME.
* Required active participation/contribution in team discussions.
* Contribute in providing solutions to work related problems.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure infrastructure designs meet organizational goals and compliance standards.
* Continuously evaluate emerging technologies to enhance infrastructure performance and security.
* Document architectural decisions and maintain up\-to\-date infrastructure guidelines.
* Support junior team members by sharing knowledge and providing guidance on infrastructure best practices.


  

Professional \& Technical Skills:
  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Oracle Database Administration (DBA).
* Strong knowledge of database backup, recovery, and performance tuning techniques.
* Experience with database security management and compliance adherence.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex database issues and optimize system performance.
* Familiarity with data replication, clustering, and high availability solutions.
* Understanding of storage management and integration with database systems.


  

Additional Information:
  

* The candidate should have minimum 2 years of experience in Oracle Database Administration (DBA).
* This position is based at our Kolkata office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

  

15 years full time education

title: QA senior lead
description:

Design and maintain scalable automation frameworks using JavaScript/Jest and/or Python/Pytest. Integrate API automation and JSON schema validation into CI/CD pipelines. Design and execute high\-volume load and performance testing using Locust. Analyse bottlenecks across ALB, ECS, downstream services, API latency, and search performance.
